usedFor: Listclean keeps email lists clean, and “Verify Email Address” checks whether an address is valid.

bestTemplate.name: “New Meeting” in Google Meet, then “Verify Email Address” in Listclean
bestTemplate.why: A new meeting can bring in an address that gets checked before anyone uses it.

watchOut: “Verify Email Address” only reports whether an address is valid, so decide what happens to bad ones.
